Offset fixes a constant delay of all subtitles (+ = later).
Lead-in shows each word slightly before it is heard – it feels more in sync.

presnost.large-v3.popis: Best speech recognition, even with unclear pronunciation and noise. Slowest – on a CPU about as long as the video.
presnost.turbo.popis: Almost as accurate, about 3× faster. A good choice for weaker computers and long videos.
presnost.medium.popis: Smaller model – needs the least graphics memory. Fine for clear speech, otherwise makes more mistakes.

oaplikaci.soukromi: Everything runs only on your computer – videos, subtitles and settings are never sent anywhere. The app goes online only to download models (with your consent) and to check for new versions.
uvitani.text: This is a test (BETA) version — it may contain bugs and some features may still change. The app is free and provided as is, without warranty (GPL-3.0 licence). It never overwrites your original videos, but we still recommend keeping backups. All videos are processed only on your computer.
